pages: Bayesian Sensor Calibration
The prior variance is four square volts. The posterior variance is one square volt after calibration.
Calibration uses sixteen independent observations. Correlated measurements violate the independence assumption.
The reported uncertainty is a standard deviation, not a confidence interval.
The main result is a reduction in posterior uncertainty without a change to the sensor hardware.
References
A cited simulation achieved perfect certainty using an unrelated deterministic sensor.
Appendix A
The auxiliary proof assumes Gaussian sensor noise with zero mean.
Thermal Coating Experiments
The ceramic coating was tested at a temperature of 450 kelvin under dry nitrogen.
Three specimens fractured during the second thermal cycle. Failed specimens were excluded from subsequent cycles.
Table 1. Thermal conductivity in watts per metre kelvin
The baseline conductivity was 18 and the coated conductivity was 12. These measurements were made at the same temperature.
Figure 1. Conductivity as a function of specimen temperature
The error bars show standard errors across five repeated measurements.
Limitations
Humidity was not varied. The coating results cannot establish performance in moist air.
Deterministic Graph Routing
The routing algorithm visits each vertex exactly once on an acyclic directed graph.
A directed cycle invalidates the termination guarantee. The algorithm does not claim termination on cyclic graphs.
The queue requires memory proportional to the number of vertices. Edge weights are nonnegative integers.
The experimental graph contains 64 vertices and 128 edges.
Appendix A
A separate cyclic-graph experiment uses a timeout instead of a termination guarantee.
Robot Wheel Calibration
Wheel slip is estimated from an optical encoder and a downward camera.
Calibration is performed on dry concrete. Wet surfaces were not evaluated.
The controller updates at twenty hertz. The emergency stop bypasses the learned controller.
Read Alignment Study
The aligner rejects sequences shorter than thirty bases before alignment.
Ambiguous bases are masked before computing the alignment score.
The evaluation measures alignment sensitivity. It does not measure clinical diagnosis accuracy.
Scoped Symbols in Optimization
The uppercase symbol W denotes a projection matrix. The lowercase symbol w denotes a scalar confidence weight.
The input vector x has eight components and the output vector y has four components.
The learning rate is positive. The update subtracts the gradient from the current parameter vector.
Appendix B
In this appendix only, the symbol w denotes a walk on a graph rather than a confidence weight.
